candidates.source_name: e-Prokurimi — Kosovo national e-procurement portal (KRPP/PPRC)
candidates.why_relevant: Legally mandatory central publication point for every contracting authority in Kosovo under Law No. 04/L-042. All contract notices (njoftim per kontrate), award notices (njoftim per dhenie te kontrates, form B08) and signature notices for banking, card, ATM, POS, core-banking and cash-handling lots are published here first, by the buyer itself. Highest-density primary source for workstream A2 in this country.
candidates.access_status: public front-end; notice detail pages are publicly readable, but the bidding/document-management application requires a registered login
candidates.legal_status: official government publication, public by law
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the OCDS API (see ocdskrpp.rks-gov.net) as the machine channel; use the portal only for notice-PDF retrieval by document id and for forms/legislation. Polite rate limiting, sq/sr/en language variants.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + local-language search, then navigation of portal nav tree
queries_used: e-prokurimi Kosovë njoftim për dhënie të kontratës shërbime bankare
KRPP PPRC Kosovo public procurement regulatory commission e-procurement platform notices

candidates.access_status: appears publicly readable per search-engine indexing; unverified by me
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Resolve tenderNumber -> document id via the KRPP API Document endpoint, then fetch the detail page / attached PDF. Do not enumerate ids blindly.

candidates.source_name: KRPP OCDS Web API (krppAPI) — open contracting data for Kosovo
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable OCDS feed of the national platform. Documented endpoints include TenderRelease, Tender, TenderUpdate, Award, Bid, Tenderers, Parties, PartyRole and Document, with filters for date range, party name, tender name, tender number and value threshold — exactly the shape needed to pull banking/payments award notices and winning suppliers on a schedule. This is the single best long-term collection channel for the cell.
candidates.access_status: public API, no authentication documented on the Help page
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled incremental pulls: GET krppAPI/Award and krppAPI/TenderRelease with endDateFrom/endDateEnd windows; keyword-filter tendername on sq/sr/en banking terms; join Parties/Tenderers for supplier mapping. Handle documented data-quality issues (nulls, field-name typos).
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowballed from Open Contracting Partnership data registry entry for Kosovo
queries_used: KRPP PPRC Kosovo public procurement regulatory commission e-procurement platform notices

candidates.source_name: OCP Data Registry — Kosovo: Public Procurement Regulatory Commission (bulk OCDS downloads)
candidates.why_relevant: Mirrors and documents the KRPP OCDS publication: coverage March 2016 – March 2026, monthly refresh, ~75,710 tenders / 211,313 parties, downloadable as JSONL.gz, XLSX and CSV per year or all-time. Gives an instant historical backfill of Kosovo award notices without hammering the national portal, plus a documented data-quality assessment.
candidates.legal_status: open data republished under OCP registry terms
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off all-time bulk download for backfill; then rely on the live krppAPI for deltas. Re-pull the registry snapshot quarterly to catch retroactive corrections.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search result, then fetched and read
queries_used: KRPP PPRC Kosovo public procurement regulatory commission e-procurement platform notices

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF fetch from the Raportet Vjetore directory (shq/srb/eng subfolders); parse statistical tables.

candidates.source_name: AQP — Agjencia Qendrore e Prokurimit (Central Procurement Agency)
candidates.why_relevant: Runs centralised procurement on behalf of all Kosovo public institutions (reported >EUR 40m/yr in centralised contracts). Cross-government banking, payment-processing and cash-handling services are exactly the 'commonly used item' category that gets centralised here, so a single AQP framework contract can replace dozens of individual authority tenders — a structural blind spot if only the notice feed is monitored.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl of the 'Kontratat e Centralizuara' and 'Kontrata Tjera' listing pages; diff against previous snapshot; join back to e-Prokurimi tender numbers where cited.
candidates.discovered_via_method: outbound link from e-prokurimi nav + local-language search
queries_used: Agjencia Qendrore e Prokurimit AQP kontratat e centralizuara shërbime bankare Kosovë

candidates.source_name: OSHP — Organi Shqyrtues i Prokurimit (Procurement Review Body)
candidates.why_relevant: Independent complaints body whose binding decisions can annul or re-run banking/payments awards. Decisions reveal bidder identities, evaluation criteria and pricing disputes that the award notice itself does not disclose, and they are the earliest signal that a contract will not proceed as announced. Also publishes an economic-operator blacklist.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of decision listings and the ComplaintByBlackList report; key decisions to tender number so they can be joined to OCDS awards.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + outbound link from e-prokurimi
queries_used: Organi Shqyrtues i Prokurimit OSHP vendime ankesa kontratë

candidates.why_relevant: Third-party searchable database of OSHP decisions, typically easier to query and to scrape than the official site, and useful as a cross-check when the official listing is incomplete or reorganised.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the vendimet listing with keyword filters; always treat the official OSHP record as authoritative when the two disagree.

negative_findings.description: The e-Prokurimi document-management path https://e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net/SPIN_PROD/APPLICATION/IPN/DocumentManagement/DokumentiFrm.aspx returned an Albanian login form (Emri i shfrytëzuesit / Fjalëkalimi), not a public notice list.
negative_findings.result_summary: Login wall on the notice-list form path. This is a HYPOTHESIS about that specific path only — individual notice detail pages under the same tree (DokumentPodaciFrm.aspx?id=) are search-engine indexed and appear publicly readable, and the platform documentation refers to a public 'Lista e Njoftimeve' view whose exact public URL I did not confirm.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collector must not assume a scrapeable HTML notice list on the portal. The OCDS API (ocdskrpp.rks-gov.net/krppAPI) should be the primary channel, with portal document fetches keyed by id resolved from the API.

negative_findings.description: No Serbian-language Kosovo-institution procurement search interface was located; sr-language queries returned Kosovo secondary legislation in Serbian on e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net plus Republic-of-Serbia sources (kim.gov.rs, paragraf.rs) that are jurisdictionally different.
negative_findings.result_summary: Serbian terminology for Kosovo notices is confirmed and usable ('javne nabavke', 'obaveštenje o dodeli ugovora', 'ugovor o uslugama'), and the platform does publish sr-language legislation, but I found no separate sr-language notice portal — the sr content lives inside the same platform.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serbian-language collection should be implemented as a language parameter/keyword set against the same national platform, not as a separate source. Serbia-hosted 'Kosovo' procurement pages must be excluded to avoid jurisdictional contamination.

negative_findings.description: No specific Kosovo public-sector award notice for ATM, POS, card-issuance or core-banking lots was surfaced by open web search in either sq or en within this scouting pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Topical searches returned only foreign tenders (Ethiopia) and commercial aggregator landing pages. The only concrete Kosovo banking-adjacent notice found was a BQK life-insurance service award, which is not in scope.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Absence of search-engine visibility is not absence of notices — these lots are almost certainly present inside the platform but invisible to general web search because notice bodies are behind the application. Confirms that keyword search must be run against the OCDS API fields (tendername, Award), not against Google.

negative_findings.description: The KRPP OCDS API endpoints were read from the auto-generated ASP.NET Help page, which states 'No documentation available' for every method; response formats, DataFormat values, pagination behaviour, rate limits and whether CPV codes are exposed are all undocumented.
negative_findings.result_summary: Endpoint list is reliable; endpoint semantics are not. No authentication is mentioned, which suggests open access but does not prove it.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: An implementation pass must empirically probe Award and TenderRelease before the collector design is fixed; in particular whether banking/payments lots can be filtered by CPV or only by free-text tendername determines the whole keyword strategy.

negative_findings.description: The OCP Data Registry entry for Kosovo PPRC explicitly documents quality problems in the published OCDS: null values and field-name typos across a corpus of 75,710 tenders / 211,313 parties.
negative_findings.result_summary: Known-defective official open data, still the best available machine channel.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any supplier-concentration or value analysis built on this feed needs defensive parsing and a field-name normalisation layer, or banking/payments lots will be silently dropped.

coverage_gaps.description: I did not establish whether Kosovo notices carry CPV codes and, if so, whether the OCDS feed exposes them. Without CPV, banking/payments lots must be identified by trilingual free-text matching, which is far noisier.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe krppAPI/Tender and krppAPI/Award for a CPV/classification field; if absent, build and tune a sq/sr/en keyword filter (shërbime bankare, kartela, bankomat/ATM, terminal POS, sistem bazë bankar, transport i parave/vlerave; bankarske usluge, kartice, bankomat, POS terminal) and measure precision against a hand-labelled sample.

coverage_gaps.description: Public enterprises (ndërmarrjet publike — KEK, Posta e Kosovës, Telekomi i Kosovës, regional water companies) are major buyers of cash-collection, POS and payment-acceptance services and may procure under utility rules or publish on their own sites; I did not map their individual procurement pages.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a per-enterprise buyer registry with each entity's procurement/notice page URL and cross-check against the platform's contracting-authority list.

coverage_gaps.description: The public 'Lista e Njoftimeve' (daily list of published notices) view referenced in e-Prokurimi user documentation was not located at a confirmed public URL.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Retrieve the e-Prokurimi user manual from the MANUALET section (ClanakItemNew.aspx?id=378) and extract the exact public notice-list path; verify with a browser session rather than a bare fetch.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage was exercised only at the terminology level (legislation and form names). I did not confirm whether individual notice bodies for banking lots are actually published in Serbian on the platform or only in Albanian.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sample notices via the API and inspect the language of tendername/description fields; if Serbian bodies exist, add them to the keyword filter and record the language field per record.

coverage_gaps.description: Contract signature notices and contract-modification/annex notices were not separately confirmed as distinct, retrievable notice types in the feed — only contract notices and award notices were.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the KRPP standard form codes (B-series, e.g. B08) from the Rules and Operational Guideline PDF and map each to the OCDS release tags exposed by krppAPI, so signature and modification events are not lost.

coverage_gaps.description: Donor and IFI procurement inside Kosovo (EU Office/IPA, World Bank, EBRD, UNDP) for financial-sector and payment-infrastructure projects sits entirely outside the national platform; I sampled only IOM.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add the EU Office in Kosovo, UNDP Kosovo, World Bank and EBRD procurement notice feeds as a separate sub-cell, filtered to Kosovo country code.

brief: Kosovo's procurement notice landscape is unusually well-centralised for the region: the Public Procurement Law obliges every contracting authority to publish on e-Prokurimi (KRPP/PPRC), and — crucially for us — KRPP additionally exposes that corpus as an open OCDS Web API (ocdskrpp.rks-gov.net/krppAPI) with Award, TenderRelease, Parties and Document endpoints, mirrored as bulk JSONL/CSV/XLSX downloads via the Open Contracting Partnership registry covering March 2016 to March 2026. The API, not the web portal, should be the backbone of collection: the portal's document-management application sits behind a login, although individual notice pages are id-addressable and indexed. Three complementary layers close the gaps — buyer-side pages (above all BQK, the most domain-relevant authority, which publishes its own award notices) plus AQP for centralised framework contracts that would otherwise be invisible as dozens of missing individual tenders; oversight sources (OSHP decisions and blacklist, ZKA audits) that reveal bidders, prices and annulments the notices omit; and a mature civil-society layer (prokurimihapur.org, redflags.dplus.org, oshp.dplus.org, KALLXO/BIRN) useful for validation and lead generation but never as the system of record. The main open risk is topical selection: it is not yet confirmed that CPV classification is exposed, so identifying banking, card, ATM, POS and cash-handling lots may depend on trilingual free-text matching that must be tuned and measured.
